features.fullDescription: Single segmental arch flanked by two storm water arches. Rubble, dressed voussoirs, cut waters carried up to refuges, 10 ft wide between parapets. Late 18th century. Picturesque.

features.name: Tollhouse, Bridge Of Feugh
features.fullDescription: Small quaint single-storey and attic, harl and slate with semi-octagonal bay front. Late 18th century.
